newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish industrial output up 7.5 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Polish industrial output up 7.5 pct in October.

text.p: Poland's industrial output (unadjusted) rose 7.5 percent in October after a 5.3 percent rise in September, and was 13.9 percent higher than in October 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
Industrial output in the January-October period of 1996 was 9.5 percent higher than in the same period of last year. In January-October 1995 it was 11.0 percent higher than in same period of 1994.
POLISH INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT OCTOBER SEPTEMBER OCT 1995
NOTES - Revised data in brackets. October 1996 had 24 working days, October 1995 had 23 and September 1996 had 22 working days.
* October 1995 index is based on a monthly average from 1992.
